title: Require Service Platform Independence
forbids: production service source that directly acquires a Node or Bun platform module
why: Services own domain behavior over ready context capabilities; concrete platform acquisition belongs to a qualified host, resource, or provider.
remediate: Move filesystem, process, storage, or runtime acquisition to a qualified host, resource, or provider and pass its ready capability through service context.
message: Production service source must not import concrete Node or Bun platform modules.
